purpose: Bind Zero/EntityOS cognitive process semantics to size-independent typed work, explicit DB-vs-simulation placement, routing, execution, workspace re-entry, Claude Code handoff, model-specific J-Space measurement, and deterministic truth/effect boundaries.

rules: process_id MUST be AZP01..AZP20
entry_event_sha256 and entry_admission_sha256 MUST be the exact digests returned by Typed Entry admission, never caller-minted aliases
capability claims inside model/workspace payloads cannot broaden capability_scope_ref
generation and required_state_epoch are mandatory fail-closed bindings
grid size N and physical executor identity MUST NOT participate in semantic work_id
stale generation or expired lease rejects execution
route selection grants no new capability
executor_class may select HCU small-model, Claude Code, or deterministic boundary without changing semantic process identity
result cannot directly mutate S0
UNKNOWN cannot be normalized to false
model consensus does not promote output_class
selection is atomic per OPEN workspace epoch
workspace recurrence cannot mint truth
stale epoch re-entry fails closed
placement decision is not a database write
durable exact queryable or restart-surviving state belongs in DATABASE_S0 unless a deterministic policy explicitly rejects admission
model-generated content cannot self-promote from S1 or S2 into DATABASE_S0
ambiguous epistemic status remains candidate or UNKNOWN and cannot become canonical fact merely because DATABASE_S0 storage is requested
proposal is not a write
only deterministic admission may mutate canonical database state
proposal requires a StatePlacementDecision selecting DATABASE_S0
conflicting epoch must reject or re-evaluate
Claude Code is the strong model/tool/code partner, not canonical truth authority
TEXT_TOOL_SESSION is the conservative default interface class
DECLARED_DEEPER_INTERFACE requires an exact exposed-interface causal evidence reference; no activation-level Global J-Space claim is permitted from prompt or session presence alone
returned text/tool output re-enters through WorkspacePacket/CognitiveResult as candidate or evidence-bound state
tool capability scope is externally admitted and cannot be broadened by Claude Code output
missing exact model runtime or interface identity => UNKNOWN
text handoff alone cannot be relabeled activation-level coupling
frozen v1 structural controller negative evidence cannot be erased or retuned on its holdout
successor control requires separately preregistered fresh-holdout evidence
credit_scope must remain component-bounded
proposal never executes directly
EffectGate and EffectJournal remain the only real-effect authority
unknown external outcome is never blindly replayed
this packet is emitted only by the deterministic EffectGate/EffectJournal boundary
model or workspace output cannot fabricate an EffectJournalReceipt
UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN until separately verified and never authorizes blind replay

cross_process_invariants: semantic process identity is independent of module identity and grid size N
same module/runtime may execute different AZP process_ids when route/capability bindings permit
all cognitive packets reuse Typed Entry entry_event_sha256 and entry_admission_sha256; this ABI cannot mint a parallel causal-event or admission identity
durable-data-vs-simulation placement is explicit through StatePlacementDecision; durable exact queryable restart-surviving data belongs in S0 database while transient cognition remains S1/S2
cognitive/model/workspace/J-Space outputs never mint canonical truth
all canonical S0 mutations are deterministic admitted writes or EffectGate/EffectJournal effects
generation, state epoch, provenance, route, executor and input digest are end-to-end bound
restart/rejoin must not create a new causal event or self-grant coordinator/effect authority
Claude Code bridge packets are part of inference, workspace broadcast and result re-entry, not acceptance-only telemetry
Claude Code handoff is typed and causally re-entered; prompt/session presence alone is not Global J-Space evidence
frozen structural native v1 J-Space behavioral failure remains negative executable evidence and is not posthoc retuned on its holdout
no fixed personality or permanent role is required for any module

first_executable_discriminator.name: VARIABLE_ROLE_DB_CLAUDE_REJOIN_ABI_SMOKE
steps: admit one Typed Entry and bind every downstream packet to its exact entry_event_sha256 and entry_admission_sha256
create two dependent CognitiveWorkUnits with different AZP process_ids and route both sequentially to the same admitted executor/runtime identity
classify one durable restart-surviving datum as DATABASE_S0 and one transient hypothesis as WORKSPACE_S1 or LOCAL_EPHEMERAL_S2 using StatePlacementDecision
restart executor between work units and rejoin using generation/state-epoch plus the original Typed Entry digest bindings
perform one AZP06 GRID_TO_CLAUDE_CODE TEXT_TOOL_SESSION bridge and one CLAUDE_CODE_TO_GRID result re-entry through AZP13 without claiming activation-level access
emit causally bound CognitiveResults and one WorkspacePacket re-entry
attempt stale-generation, mismatched-entry-digest, self-granted-capability, direct-S0-write, and deeper-interface-without-evidence variants and require rejection
first_executable_discriminator.pass: same runtime executes two cognitive process types across restart, DB-vs-simulation placement remains correct, Claude Code round-trip re-enters causally, and all five fail-closed negatives are rejected
